LanguageData.HD_Ballistics_DebugImpacts_Desc: In developer mode, show the latest physical impact above each target: penetration, stopping or ricochet, impact angle, and remaining kinetic energy. Shots without a physical armour decision are marked separately. White lines show incoming fire; coloured lines show the remaining trajectory.
LanguageData.HD_Ballistics_DebugSpall_Desc: In developer mode, show the actual representative fragment rays used by the vehicle damage calculation, including HESH scabs and internal warhead fragments. Each line represents a bundle, rather than one fragment. The view is projected onto the map; vertical spread can overlap. No extra fragments are simulated.
LanguageData.HD_Ballistics_DebugJet: Jet penetration potential: {0} → {1} mm RHA equivalent
LanguageData.HD_Ballistics_DebugLegend: Fragment paths: <color=#FFA626>orange: continues</color> · <color=#59CCFF>blue: stopped</color> · <color=#FF40E6>magenta: crew hit</color> Crosses mark stops and the first crew hit on each ray. Up to 32 recent hits are retained.
